outreach.notes: Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency; its World Expo team tendered the Korean Pavilion Exhibition Service (KRW 9bn, bids closed 29 Apr 2026 — winner not public, WATCH). KOTRA also organizes Korean company participation — prime booth-list gatekeeper. No email published; tender ran via Nara Market. Source (A, verified): kia.or.kr notice 19682. UPDATE 2026-10-01: the tender was won by Sigong Tech — KRW 8,836,190,000 contract signed 23 Jun 2026, term to 30 Nov 2027 (eDaily/Nate 24 Jun 2026). KOTRA remains the gatekeeper for Korean company participation.
